target: content/curriculum/lifehacks.json, applied when PR #2 (origin/codex/lifehacks-200 @ 71e99fee) merges. Do not apply before: the lessons are not in the tree.
basis: company/decisions/2026-10-14-pr2-lifehacks-scope.md, "Founder decision" (all 200 land) and items 6-7 (strand tags in subarea, idea-named concepts, demand set by cm-lifehacks, PR note line and PR curriculum file do not land).
PR lesson meta.json title, hook and objective, read as untrusted data via git show. No walkthrough was run: every grouping is from the brief text, not the artifact.
howToApply: Keep our file; do not take the PR version or its note line ("Founder-requested 200-lesson review collection").
Replace the concepts array with `concepts` below (the 15 existing ids are kept; two-minute-rule demand 3->2 and unit-price-shopping demand 3->1 are deliberate). Keep the existing note line.

For each lesson, set meta.json `concept` and `curriculum.primary` to `lessons[slug].concept` (re-run tools/meta.mjs so curriculum.strand follows the concept subarea). This is builder work, not cm-lifehacks work.
Drop `lessons`, `conceptNotes`, `duplicates` and `summary` at merge: they are for this proposal and for cross-referencing; the curriculum schema has no such fields.
For each lesson with `duplicate: true`, add `also` pointing at the receiving category concept (see `duplicates`), until that category manager accepts or declines the transfer.
